dedupe_keys.name: high resolution water demand dataset from a district metered area in the krizevci area croatia 2023 2024

description: A Croatian research team publishes fifteen-minute district-metered water-demand and weather CSVs for the Križevci area. Zenodo provides the tables and a README under CC BY-NC 4.0. Pumping-station meter data span January 2023 through December 2024 in UTC. The README defines flow in cubic metres per hour, weather columns, aggregation from one-minute readings and benchmark time splits. These observations can calibrate short-term water-demand and anomaly-detection simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this district time series. Coverage is one service area, not customer-level use or an entire city. A limitation is that short raw gaps were interpolated before aggregation, longer gaps remain NaN and a centred rolling mean smooths the flow series. Weather came from Open-Meteo and was interpolated from hourly values. No CSV was downloaded or meter calibration checked.
